name: ai-pass
description: Add user-funded multi-model AI to web, mobile, server, ChatGPT, and open-source applications through AI Pass SDK, OAuth, or REST.

interface.shortDescription: Add user-funded AI to any app.
interface.longDescription: Integrate AI Pass where an application already lives using the browser SDK, OAuth, or the OpenAI-compatible REST API. Users connect one wallet and fund exact model usage without exposing provider keys.
capabilities: Integrate user-funded AI in web, mobile, desktop, server, and ChatGPT apps
Provision public OAuth clients through browser-approved device authorization
Call text, image, speech, transcription, embedding, and video models
Preserve existing hosting, authentication, billing, and provider routes
interface.defaultPrompt: Add AI Pass to this application so end users can connect their own wallet and fund model usage. Preserve the current hosting, authentication, deployment, billing, and providers unless I explicitly ask to replace them.
